steps: Check current insulation depth against your region's recommended R-value.
Air-seal attic penetrations (can lights, plumbing stacks) before adding insulation.
Choose batt, blown-in, or spray foam based on attic access and budget.
Wear a respirator, gloves, and coveralls; lay boards to walk on joists safely.
Layer new insulation perpendicular to existing for full coverage; leave soffit vents clear.
